answer: Picture each new agent as a sparrow that must cross a bridge into the trusted market. Reputation flows along real trade edges from seed agents via short random walks, so credit reaching any node is capped by how many honest partners actually paid it. A sybil flock can puff up a plume of fake mutual deals, but those links only connect fakes to each other; the attacker must win genuine trades with honest agents to get trust across, and each such edge costs real work and money.
